page_note: Page is dominated by substrate cosmological teaching about three orders of emanations from the Father — 'gods', 'rich-ones', 'angels' — reckoned to three houses (Greatness/Spirit, Beloved of Lights, Ambassador of Glory). The teaching maps cosmos→cosmos throughout: names, callings, embassies, the contest with Enmity. Editorial seams are concentrated in three places: (1) the 'Once again, hear him' frame at i=11 introducing the second visage; (2) the 'Illuminator said' formula at i=26; (3) the chapter ornament/title at i=33-34 ('Concerning the First Man') and the new chapter opening at i=35. The fatigue score reflects these terminal frame insertions but the bulk of the page is intact substrate.
